intro: Braelyn Firehand at Sunrock Retreat uses her arcane sight to track down Keeper Ordanus, an elder son of Cenarius who fled Stonetalon Peak. Believing his people desecrated ancient Highborne ruins, she sends Horde champions across the border into Ashenvale to take his head.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: They thought that they could halt the flow of magic. They were mistaken. They thought that they could hide Ordanus, but I will have his head!

Magic grants me true sight. Yes... There he is. A crossroads... At the top of a great tree in Ashenvale Forest. A name... Raynewood. One of the eldest sons of the forest god. They spirited him away from the peak before I could find him, but his time runs short.
Bring it to me and I will share with you a mighty gift.

clips.title: Progress
paras: When my master bade me to the peak of Stonetalon, I expected that all I would need was to lay waste to the night elves that crawled the sacred ruins of our ancient temple of Azshara, their touch despoiling its sanctity... But Ordanus had slipped my grasp.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew Ordanus once, long ago. He had the arrogance of his kind, holding himself above even the Highborne.
His head does not rise so high now, does it, friend?
I promised you a reward, and you shall have it. Attend to me.
